source_note: Generic templates authored for study/practice (Phase 9). They do not satisfy any particular firm's audit methodology.

templates.guidance: Complete before fieldwork begins. Tailor materiality and risk assessment to the engagement.
templates.purpose: Document the audit plan: understanding, materiality, risk assessment and resource allocation.

items.prompt: Describe the entity's business, industry and key customers/suppliers.
List significant accounting policies and any changes this period.
Significant risks identified (link to risk register refs).
Planned responses to each significant risk.

templates.title: Audit planning checklist

templates.guidance: One row per identified risk. Link each risk to the audit-risk library where possible.
templates.purpose: Central register of identified risks of material misstatement.

items.prompt: Inherent risk factors (complexity, judgement, susceptibility to fraud).

templates.title: Risk register

templates.guidance: Describe the control as designed; walkthrough evidence goes in the evidence register.

items.prompt: Control description (who does what, when, how).
Preventive or detective? Manual or automated?

templates.title: Control description

templates.guidance: Test operating effectiveness over the reliance period. Any deviation is an exception — log it.
templates.title: Test of control

templates.guidance: Link to the audit-risk library procedure where applicable.
templates.purpose: Document a substantive procedure and its results.
templates.title: Substantive procedure workpaper

templates.guidance: Log every piece of evidence relied upon, with its source and reliability.

items.prompt: Reliability assessment (original vs copy, independent vs internal).

templates.title: Evidence register

templates.guidance: Reviewer completes independently of the preparer.
templates.title: Working paper review checklist

templates.guidance: Complete at the end of the engagement before reporting.

items.prompt: All planned procedures completed or documented as not required?
All exceptions cleared or evaluated for impact?
Subsequent events reviewed up to the report date?
Uncorrected misstatements schedule prepared and evaluated?
Independence and ethics confirmations in place?
File assembled and archived per policy?

templates.title: Engagement completion checklist

templates.guidance: Every exception gets a row; nothing is cleared without a resolution note.
templates.title: Exception log
